candidates.description: This feature vector represents common Spanish verbs, verb roots, and related grammatical forms, particularly those associated with actions like doing, making, and saying.
This vector represents numeric digit tokens, likely corresponding to numerical data, numeric IDs, or counts.
This vector represents common Spanish grammatical words, functional prefixes, and suffixes.
This feature activates for Latin or Greek numerical prefixes and root-like word fragments related to measurement, science, and nomenclature.
This vector activates for tokens related to the root word "cap" and words sharing the same phonetic or orthographic prefix.
This feature activates on tokens ending with the letters 'en'.
This vector represents the concept of variety, plurality, and multiple items or instances in Spanish.
This vector represents legal, judicial, and administrative terminology.
This vector represents degree, quantity, and extent across different languages and grammatical forms.
Demonstrative determiners and pronouns in Spanish.
